# MOJO4K.DE – Bester IPTV Anbieter Deutschland

> MOJO4K.DE is Germany's #1 rated IPTV provider (4.9/5 stars, 500,000+ customers). We deliver 50,000+ live TV channels in 4K Ultra HD plus 120,000+ on-demand titles – instantly, without contracts.

## Service Overview
- 50,000+ live TV channels (SD, HD, Full HD, 4K Ultra HD)
- 120,000+ movies and series on demand (VOD)
- Full German channel lineup: ARD, ZDF, RTL, Sat.1, ProSieben, Kabel 1, VOX, Sport1, n-tv, WELT, ARTE, 3sat
- Premium sport channels: Sky Sport (all packages), DAZN, Eurosport, BeIN Sports, Sport1+
- Major competitions: Bundesliga, Champions League, Europa League, DFB Pokal, Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Ligue 1
- International channels: Turkish, Arabic, English, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Albanian, Greek, Hindi, Persian, Dutch, Swedish and more
- Austrian channels: ORF 1, ORF 2, ATV, Puls4
- Swiss channels: SRF 1, SRF 2, RTS, RSI
- EPG: 14-day electronic program guide
- Catch-up TV: watch missed programmes
- Anti-freeze technology: 99.9% uptime guarantee
- 24/7 German-speaking customer support via WhatsApp

## Compatible Devices
Amazon Fire TV Stick (all models), Android TV Box, Samsung Smart TV (Tizen), LG Smart TV (WebOS), iPhone, iPad, Android smartphone/tablet, Windows PC, Mac, Apple TV, Chromecast/Google TV, MAG Box (254/322/422/524), Enigma2/Dreambox, Raspberry Pi

## Compatible IPTV Apps
TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, XCIPTV, Smart IPTV, SS IPTV, GSE Smart IPTV, IBO Player, OTT Navigator, STB Emu, Perfect Player, Kodi, VLC, Plex

## Connection Protocols
- Xtream Codes API (recommended)
- M3U playlist

## Pricing (as of 2026)
All plans: no contract, no automatic renewal, instant activation via WhatsApp
- 1 Month / 1 Device: €9
- 3 Months / 1 Device: €29
- 6 Months / 1 Device: €39
- 12 Months / 1 Device: €49
Multi-device packages available (up to 10 simultaneous connections)
Free 24-hour trial available – no credit card required
